## Checklist

- [ ] Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and followed the house patterns
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (`dart format .`, `flutter analyze` clean, `flutter test`)
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] One logical change; conventional-commit message (`feat:`, `fix:`, …)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the DCO
- [ ] Screenshots updated if the UI changed (`tool/screenshots.sh`)
